title: Sensor Raw Data Sanity Failure
body: I'm stuck on this error when starting new sensor. Any ideas? I'm using Sept 8th, 2018 version. Things have been working fine, then all of a sudden stopped. I also got some errors concerning clock synchronization and then forced a hardware reset, but still getting `Sensor Raw Data Sanity Failure` and can't calibrate to get readings. Any ideas or suggestions would be appreciated. On Android 9. I also tried to circumvent quality check and when I calibrate it says sensor raw data is outside sane range.

comments.body: I think this was mostly due to a bad transmitter. It indicated that there was more than 200 in Voltage, but it was nearing the end of 3 months (G5). After getting a new transmitter, things are back to normal. The errors were awfully odd though.
